channel.title: Finance
channel.description: Latest investing news and finance headlines straight from Wall Street.

item.title: A Chinese humanoid startup flips 'distillation' claim on OpenAI as it releases a new robotics model
item.description: Ant-backed startup JoyIn's CEO published an article in Chinese that raised questions about similarities between his company's new model and OpenAI publications.

item.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
item.description: Chinese netizens focused on the price of Apple’s iPhone Duo, as cheaper Xiaomi and Huawei foldables raise value comparisons and muddle the foldable's reception.

item.title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services
item.description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, targeting the labor-intensive research, modeling and pitchbook tasks traditionally handled by junior bankers.

item.title: Kalshi launches ‘perps’ for gold and silver following CFTC approval, expanding futures offerings
item.description: Its the latest move by the prediction market company to diversify its assets users can trade.

item.title: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
item.description: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International are working on common standards for AI-agent payments — including ways to verify and monitor their transactions.

item.title: Adani Enterprises shares jump as airport unit enters into $1 billion fundraising deal
item.description: The investors will subscribe to new shares in three tranches and collectively own about 5.54% of the airport operator after the final tranche.

item.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
item.description: As Chinese electric car sales slow and share prices tumble, several of the automakers are ramping up humanoid robotics development.

item.title: How one hedge-fund manager built his firm to be powered entirely by AI agents
item.description: It's a stark example of a growing reality on Wall Street as firms test the benefits and limits of AI in finance and on their employees.

item.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges
item.description: Visa is doubling down on blockchain-powered financial services with a new program to help issuers of stablecoin-linked cards access loans.

item.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks
item.description: More than 60% of cryptocurrency platforms that lost money due to cyberattacks had undergone independent security audits, CoinGecko said.

item.title: China says it will pump $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
item.description: With a bigger capital cushion, financial institutions may also be asked to do more to mobilize resources in capital markets, analysts say.

item.title: Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here
item.description: The sweetener's prices surged last week, reflecting a sharp deterioration in the global supply outlook.

item.title: White House has vetted candidates for key CFTC vacancies, sources tell CNBC. It's unclear if they will be filled
item.description: Filling open commissioner positions at the regulatory agency has been a sticking point in negotiations over the Clarity Act.

item.title: Bitcoin heads for third winning week in a row as macro pressures mount
item.description: Bitcoin headed for its third straight winning week, as traders searched for refuge amid volatile moves in equities, currencies and bond markets.

item.title: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
item.description: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.

item.title: New York Fed's Williams says yield surge due to strong economic prospects
item.description: New York Fed President John Williams said higher Treasury yields reflect a strong economy as he weighs whether another interest rate hike is needed.

item.title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel says Japanese bond yields not a challenge for trading houses right now
item.description: In an appearance on CNBC's "Squawk Box," Greg Abel said that yields in the country are still relatively low.

item.title: Nepal’s mountain tourism industry faces ‘serious warning’ after Himalayan flood disaster
item.description: Nepal's devastating floods have raised fresh concerns for the country's vital adventure tourism industry ahead of its peak travel season.

item.title: Prediction market traders think job creation rebounded in August
item.description: Traders see 50-50 odds that the U.S. economy added more than 50,000 jobs last month.

item.title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease
item.description: The policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has prevailed above the Fed's 2% target.

item.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
item.description: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

item.title: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
item.description: The path toward the move still looks cluttered.

item.title: Aon CEO says insurance broker seeks to build 'premiere middle market platform' with purchase of rival USI
item.description: The insurance broker said the merger will create the premiere U.S. middle-market platform.

item.title: Kalshi partners with brokerage Alpaca as it tries to build its international audience
item.description: The prediction market platform and the financial infrastructure and brokerage startup are working to get Kalshi's event contracts to global investors.

item.title: Crypto exchange Gemini not at fault for collapse of Earn lending program, arbitrator says
item.description: An arbitrator earlier this month said Gemini Space Station did not mislead users of its Earn program.

item.title: China's Xi builds diplomatic clout with multiple state visits ahead of Trump summit
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to make his first visit to India before traveling to the U.S. for a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Jackson Hole analyst roundup: Warsh's speech sends hike chances higher, may put Fed 'at odds' with Treasury
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish stance reinforced expectations of a relatively tighter stance at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting in September.

item.title: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
item.description: Corn and wheat futures have surged to their highest levels in more than three years. But the reasons for these recent rallies are notably different.

item.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
item.description: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

item.title: September Fed decision is now a coin flip as rate hike odds increase post Warsh
item.description: Odds rose after Warsh's speech in Jackson Hole, Wyo., where he discussed that he still is frustrated with the overall inflation trend.
